description: This is a shell script ('pr_cycle.sh') used for managing review lifecycle dates in a software project. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review cycles for project components, mainly by updating specific date fields in associated 'metadata.yaml' files. The script includes functions for listing components, calculating business days, and regenerating reports, along with detailed usage instructions.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds and lists all components by locating 'metadata.yaml' files outside of docs and scripts directories, and sorts them.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help information and usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date, skipping weekends.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Removes lifecycle date entries ('review_started', 'review_deadline', 'target_green_date') in a metadata YAML file by resetting them to '~'.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG status report after updates.
